audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions were unmentioned: Bailout (W) delays her ADC's death and can heal them off a takedown, so Grievous Wounds timing decides whether it sticks; and Loyalty Program (E) shields allies it hits, absorbing a burst window.
